entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker and ghost hunter who can phase through walls into the realm of the dead and fights spirits with rondel daggers; she is also of noble birth and has a big job coming from the Black Rose.

entities.name: Emilio Revari
entities.description: A cocky, nervous nobleman, the third son of a noble house and the duke's younger brother, who hires Kaya to rid his late mother's manor of a ghost.

entities.name: Revari's Mother
entities.description: The ghost of Emilio Revari's mother, a clawed, needle-toothed old woman who haunts her manor and guards her own hidden corpse.

entities.name: Wasp's Nest
entities.description: A rough tavern where Kaya meets Revari's soldier before being taken upstairs to see Revari.

entities.name: Paliano
entities.description: The fiefdom or city where the Revari estate lies, a few miles from the haunted manor.

entities.name: Revari manor
entities.description: The big manor Revari inherited from his mother, wrecked by the ghost; it has a concealed crawlspace and a floorless bedroom.

entities.name: Fiora
entities.description: The plane where Kaya takes this side job.

entities.name: Black Rose
entities.description: An organization whose symbol on an unmarked envelope tells Kaya it is time for her big job.

events.summary: Kaya waits at the Wasp's Nest and her contact, a soldier in disguise wearing an iris brooch, arrives.
The soldier leads Kaya upstairs to meet his grace.
events.quote: His grace will see you now,

events.summary: Revari tells Kaya his late mother's manor is haunted, the workers refuse to enter, and he wants the ghost gone.
events.quote: there is no doubt in my mind: the place is haunted

events.summary: Kaya accepts the job despite taking an immediate dislike to Revari.
Revari pays Kaya half down and hands over the building plans.
events.quote: Half down, as I said in my letter.

events.summary: Kaya receives an unmarked envelope bearing only the Black Rose symbol, signalling that her big job has begun.
events.quote: just a symbol. The Black Rose.

events.summary: Kaya enters the manor at night and plugs her ears with wax.
events.quote: then withdrew the wax plugs from her pockets and worked them into her ears.

events.summary: Kaya taunts the spirit and the ghost appears in the east wing hallway, a clawed old woman, and shrieks at her.
events.quote: A spectral form appeared most of the way down the hallway

events.summary: Kaya phases through the wall to dodge the ghost and pins its shawl to the wall with a dagger.
events.quote: She lit up one of her daggers and pinned the shawl to the wall.

events.summary: Kaya stabs the ghost through the palm and wounds it, and it flees through the ceiling.
events.quote: Kaya blocked with the other dagger, stabbing it through the ghost's gnarled palm.

events.summary: Kaya runs into a bedroom with no floor, a secret not on the plans, and falls over the edge.
Kaya grabs the ghost's spectral shawl to catch a ride out of the pit.
events.quote: closed spectral hands around the spectral shawl

events.summary: Kaya pries up floorboards in the wrecked tea room and finds the withered corpse of an old woman resembling the ghost.
events.quote: There, in the crawlspace, was the withered corpse of an old woman.

events.summary: Among the debris Kaya finds Revari's signet ring and realizes the truth about his mother.
events.quote: A signet ring. A familiar signet ring.

events.summary: Kaya tells Revari the ghost is dealt with, and he insists on inspecting the manor before paying.
events.quote: I can't be faulted for wishing to inspect your work before remitting payment.

events.summary: Kaya leads Revari into the east wing room and quietly closes the door behind him.
events.quote: Very quietly, Kaya closed the door behind him.

events.summary: Kaya confronts Revari, calling him kinslayer, as his mother's ghost appears behind him.
events.quote: I don't want anything from you, kinslayer,

events.summary: Kaya refuses Revari's plea for help and says she is defaulting on the job with cause.
The ghost falls on Revari with teeth and claws as Kaya walks through the door and leaves him screaming.
events.quote: Then his mother's wailing ghost was upon him with those needle teeth and those dagger claws.

relations.note: She is his mother, whom he suspects refuses to leave the manor.
Kaya accuses him of kinslayer after finding the hidden corpse and his ring.
relations.quote: I don't want anything from you, kinslayer,

relations.note: He hires her as a ghost hunter and she later abandons the job.
Its symbol is sent to summon her to her big job.
relations.quote: just a symbol. The Black Rose.

relations.note: She fights and wounds the ghost before learning why it haunts the house.
relations.quote: Kaya blocked with the other dagger, stabbing it through the ghost's gnarled palm.
